newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National assembly to vote on proposal to phase out provincial government.
Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen continues to accuse Taiwan of meddling in Cambodia's recent fighting.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Nine countries raise motion supporting Taiwan's entry into United Nations.
Manufacturing industry workers to see three-percent salary raise starting August 1.
LIBERTY TIMES - Finance ministry says does not rule out loosening stock market daily cap on rises and falls.
Renowned fashion designer Gianni Versace shot to death.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Private businesses aloof towards President Lee Teng-hui's upcoming trip to Central America.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Stock market daily movement ceiling may been loosened to 10 percent.
U.S. dollar rises against Japanese yen.
